name: Dry patch finder
short: Finds parts of a field that stay drier than the rest on two or more dates.
long: Compares NDMI (plant water) and land surface temperature across every clear pass in the last six weeks and the same window in past years. Zones that stay much drier than the field median on two or more dates are flagged, sized in hectares, and checked against elevation and soil maps to suggest a cause.
limits: Pixels are 10 m; features smaller than ~3 pixels can be missed.
Optical satellites cannot see through cloud; cloudy passes are skipped.
Causes are inferred from patterns, not observed directly — confirm on the ground.

name: Weekly crop health
short: A clean NDVI map of every field after each clear pass.
long: Builds a cloud-free NDVI composite for each field contour every week, highlights zones that dropped more than 0.1 since the previous pass, and keeps a season curve you can compare with earlier years.
limits: Pixels are 10 m; features smaller than ~3 pixels can be missed.
Optical satellites cannot see through cloud; cloudy passes are skipped.
Causes are inferred from patterns, not observed directly — confirm on the ground.

name: Pasture for herders
short: Shows where grass is growing so herds can move to better grazing.
long: Combines optical greenness with radar soil moisture so the map still updates through cloudy weeks. Results are summarised per grazing block and can be sent as a short WhatsApp or text message.
limits: Pixels are 10–20 m; features smaller than ~3 pixels can be missed.
Radar can confuse wet soil with water after heavy rain.
Causes are inferred from patterns, not observed directly — confirm on the ground.

name: Small-field stress (3 m)
short: Daily 3 m stress map for fields too small for Sentinel-2.
long: Routes to PlanetScope when a field is under 2 ha so the edges are not lost in 10 m pixels. Runs the same NDMI and NDVI anomaly checks as the free version.
limits: Pixels are 3 m; features smaller than ~3 pixels can be missed.
Optical satellites cannot see through cloud; cloudy passes are skipped.
Causes are inferred from patterns, not observed directly — confirm on the ground.

name: Reservoir level tracker
short: Water surface area and height for any lake or reservoir.
long: Maps the water edge from Sentinel-2 using the NDWI index and pairs it with SWOT water-height measurements to estimate volume change over time.

Optical satellites cannot see through cloud; cloudy passes are skipped.
